found.truth_sql: SELECT count() AS o0 FROM (SELECT o.id AS c0, if(o.quantity >= 3, 'large', 'small') AS c1, toString(o.status) AS c2, nullIf(toString(o.status), 'completed') AS c3, o.user_id AS c4, 1 AS c5, o.amount AS c6 FROM shop.orders o LEFT JOIN shop.users u ON o.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN shop.products p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE 1) WHERE (toFloat64(c6) < 1) SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1
